sources.name: Pool sites + yearly states (usa/pools.py on USDA NAIP / open orthophotos)
USGS 3DEP LiDAR block points (trees, canopy, no-return outline, sun ray-cast)
EarthScope Consortium / NSF GAGE GNSS station velocities
USDA NRCS Soil Data Access (SSURGO) linear extensibility
CDC ArboNET West Nile virus activity by county, 1999-2025 (CSV behind the CDC historic-data map)
Dust / wind / hail days (NWS VTEC via IEM, NOAA NCEI Storm Events, GHCN-Daily) - meta.weather_triggers
EPA radon zones + EPA AQS design values 2023-2025 (earth_county.json)
Pool-service market: Census CBP / NES, BLS QCEW (cleaning_market.json)
FEMA NFHL flood zone per house

block.pools_within_100m_note: pool sites found by usa/pools.py in the block plus a 100 m ring
block.route_rule: nearest-neighbour walk from the pool nearest the SW corner; changing street costs +40 m

climate.uv_note: NASA POWER all-sky UV index (24-h mean, not the noon peak) is highest in Jun at 2.7 (annual mean 1.6); UV breaks down free chlorine fastest in those months
climate.sun_source: NASA POWER 2001-2025 all-sky climatology (NREL NSRDB needs an API key, not used)

wnv_county.note: ArboNET reports by county of residence; mosquito activity means standing water (green pools) matters

subsidence.note: vertical velocity of the nearest permanent GNSS station (NAM14), not measured at the block

pools.outline_note: LiDAR no-return cells connected to the pool point (yard): 34 m2, solidity 0.86

owner.method: nearest building (all Overture footprints, not a lot line)

trees.method: LiDAR vegetation returns (multi-return + single-return >= 2 m non-building) within 10 m of the pool edge; crowns = height-model local maxima > 3 m; canopy over pool = pool cells with vegetation >= 2 m

sun.method: 5-min sun positions (pvlib, meta.tz) ray-cast over the LiDAR max-return surface (0.5 m); obstacles outside the block not seen

ground.flood_zone: X (0.2 pct annual chance flood hazard)

soil.basis: component-share-weighted, 0-150 cm depth-weighted lep_r (SSURGO via SDA)

reasons: +0.5 leaf/debris load: canopy over 0% of the pool, 5 tree crowns > 3 m within 10 m (tallest 18.4 m, LiDAR)
+0.5 in storm season: 28 dust days and 13 high-wind days per year (county, NWS/NCEI)
visit.rule: 1 + 0.5 debris (canopy >= 15% or >= 4 crowns) + 0.5 dust/wind (>= 20 dust or >= 30 wind days) + 0.5 sun (>= 10 h Jun 21 and >= 5.5 kWh/m2/day) + 1 green now; cap 3

reasons: +6 trees: canopy over 0% of the pool, 5 crowns > 3 m within 10 m (LiDAR)
+5 county had West Nile human cases in 2025 (CDC ArboNET) - standing green water is a code issue
lead.rule: green now 30 (covered 12, turquoise 5) + past green 10/15 + trees <= 15 + dust <= 10 + income <= 15 + sun 5 + WNV county 5; x (0.5 + 0.5 x confidence)
